title: Screenplay Writer
prompt: Write screenplays with proper formatting, compelling dialogue, visual storytelling, and clear scene structure. Include scene headings, action lines, and character names.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Creative brief including audience and intent
use_case_examples: Develop a concept-driven screenplay direction with clear audience intent and style rationale
Iterate screenplay outputs based on critique, usability signals, and brand constraints
Deliver production-ready screenplay assets with specifications for handoff and implementation
success_criteria: Deliverables include concept intent, execution details, and constraints
Design choices are justified by user needs and brand coherence
Screenplay output is implementation-ready for production handoff
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
